tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Default ground for body text (`ink`, `ink-muted`) and for links (`brand-text`).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, the floating service strip and the header. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `brand-text`, `accent-text`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed bands, table stripes, input wells, image placeholders. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Immersive deep-teal sections: hero overlay base, stats band, call-to-action band, footer. Text on it: `on-deep`, `on-deep-muted`, `accent`.

tokens.name: surface-deep-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles that sit on `surface-deep`. Text on it: `on-deep`, `on-deep-muted`, `accent`.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface-deep` and `surface-deep-raised`.

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-deep` and `surface-deep-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, dates, captions on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines. Not for form-control edges (use `border-strong`).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and outline buttons; icon strokes that carry meaning. At least 3:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill for the teal action button and active nav marker. Text on it: `on-primary`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on `primary` and `primary-hover` fills.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet teal wash: selected rows, info badges, hover on ghost buttons. Text on it: `ink`, `brand-text`.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Links, kickers and teal emphasis in running text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold. Fill of the main call-to-action; kicker rules; and text or icons on `surface-deep`. Label on the fill: `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on `accent` and `accent-hover` fills.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold used as TEXT on page and card grounds (`surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`); on dark grounds it equals `accent`. Never place it on an `accent` fill: use `on-accent` there.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: focus-on-deep
tokens.usage: Focus ring on `surface-deep` and `surface-deep-raised`: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim laid over photography so `on-deep` text stays legible (hero, featured news). Always paired with imagery, never alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and icon for success notices on `success-surface`, `surface`, `surface-raised`. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Background of success notices and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text and icon for warnings on `warning-surface`, `surface`, `surface-raised`. Always with a triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Background of warning notices and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text and icon for errors on `danger-surface`, `surface`, `surface-raised`. Always with an alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Background of error notices and badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text and icon for informational notices on `info-surface`, `surface`, `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: Background of informational notices and badges.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Large figures in the stats band (Persian digits).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: با آخرین رویدادها، موفقیت‌ها و اطلاعیه‌های دانشگاه همراه باشید.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card summaries, form hints, footer links.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, meta lines, fine print. Never below 12px.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Small line above a section title, beside the gold rule.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: kicker to title, button gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list-item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), default grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter, page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of homepage sections (desktop).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding that makes room for the floating service strip.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, small buttons, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, notices, tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards, the service strip, hero media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pill buttons, timeline dots.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dropdown panels.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The service strip overlapping the hero.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding at every width.
